stage: G09 signed retryable failure and fallback journal
limitations: Network, provider and errors in factory tests are synthetic; database fallback receipts are signed directly by an ephemeral fixture key.
Only complete chains ending in success with signed retryable predecessors pass the transport audit; terminal, cancelled and unsigned unknown failures do not qualify.
No proof of provider completion or absence of a charge is inferred from a signed timeout observation.
